extension.name: ABPro popup caller
extension.author: Soft Ventures, Inc.
extension.copyright: Soft Ventures, Inc. All rights reserved
extension.description:
Module to call Soft Ventures' Appointment Booking Pro.

Requires ABPRo 4.0.5 or above, and Jooma 4.0 This module will present a calendar. Clicking on a day will open a popup of the ABPro booking screen.
The Appointment Booking Pro comnponent must be installed, configured and fully operational!

Version 3.0 (beta 1 February 10/20)

beta 1
  • Modied to run under Joolma 4


Note 1: This is not a stand alone booking module, it only provides a calendar to launch an ABPro booking screen.
Note 2: The popup uses an iFrame and is therefore not compatible with PayPal as PayPal does not permit a call from an iFrame.
Authorize.net and 2Checkout.com are ok with iFrames.

field.name: layout
field.label: View
field.description: Select the view to be used by this menu. (Normal or Accordian)

field.name: screen_to_display
field.label: Booking screen to display
field.description: Which booking screen to show in the popup?

field.name: mode
field.label: Display Mode
field.description: This module can launch in single resoure or single category modes.

field.name: res_cat_id
field.label: Resource or Category ID
field.description: If calling in Single Resource or Category mode, enter the Resource or Category ID here.

field.name: popup_fontsize
field.label: Datepicker Size
field.description: Default = 75. The JQuery datepicker uses font size to control the picker size. The number is a percent of the parent element's font size, so 100 = max and smaller numbers make the calendar smaller.

field.name: popup_title
field.label: Popup Title
field.description: This text will be shown as the JQuery dialog title, leave blank for no title.

field.name: popup_width
field.label: Popup Width
field.description: Width to make the popup. (default = 750)

field.name: popup_height
field.label: Popup Height
field.description: Height to make the popup. (default = 600)

field.name: mindate
field.label: Min Date
field.description: The JQuery datepicker min date, default = 1, 0=today, 1=tomorrow, etc. Must be a number. Note: in Single Resource mode, the resource settings Disable Dates Before will override this.

field.name: maxdate
field.label: Max Date
field.description: The JQuery datepicker max date, default = empty, 30=30 days from now, 14=14 dyas from now, etc. Must be a number. Note: in Single Resource mode, the resource settings Disable Dates After will override this.

field.name: header_text
field.label: Header
field.description: This text appears above the calendar. You can use a language key here and place the text in the language file.

field.name: footer_text
field.label: Footer
field.description: This text appears below the calendar. You can use a language key here and place the text in the language file.
